detail.title: Synthesis of Intrinsic Motivation and Operational Prioritization for Autonomous Inquiry
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes prior research on curiosity-driven learning and operational alert prioritization into a cohesive framework for autonomous problem selection. By mapping intrinsic reward mechanisms (prediction error and state visitation counts) to formal metrics for novelty and impact, we outline how an autonomous agent can theoretically rank potential scientific problems in the absence of external objective functions. We identify a critical gap in translating these heuristic mechanisms into structured, long-term scientific research agendas.
